REQUIRED when this PR changes implementation, schema, runtime, config or
workflows. A documentation-only PR can delete this section.

The question is NOT "did I remember to update docs". It is:

  Which claims in documents that own current / implemented architecture truth
  were invalidated, made incomplete or changed in meaning by this change?

now?" row and the canonical-documents table.

  Result: updated — a document that owns current/implemented architecture truth
                    changed, because this PR invalidated a claim in it.
          none    — you inspected the plausible owners and no current
                    implemented-architecture claim was invalidated.

`none` is a legitimate and cheap answer. The goal is an accurate assessment of
claim impact, not documentation churn. What is not acceptable is skipping the
question — CI checks that the assessment exists, not that it reached the right
answer.
-->
